requirements.title: CO_REDUCE restrictions on A
requirements.definition: A shall be nonpolymorphic, have no ultimate allocatable or pointer component, have corresponding shape, type, and type parameter values, not be coindexed, and is INTENT(INOUT).

pending.A-not-polymorphic: Source-control uses a nonpolymorphic integer A; polymorphic actuals are unnumbered restrictions without diagnostic facets here.
pending.A-no-ultimate-allocatable-or-pointer-com: Source-control uses intrinsic integer or a simple derived type with no pointer/allocatable ultimate components; violating types are unnumbered restrictions without diagnostic facets here.
pending.A-corresponding-same-shape-type-paramete: Source-control only across corresponding references; no executable oracle is claimed for CO_REDUCE argument correspondence in the single-image suite.
pending.A-not-coindexed: Source-control uses local noncoindexed A; coindexed actuals are unnumbered restrictions without diagnostic facets here.
pending.A-intent-inout: Source-control records that A is INTENT(INOUT); no local singleton execution is used as an oracle for a CO_* intrinsic.

requirements.title: CO_REDUCE restrictions on OPERATION
requirements.definition: OPERATION shall be a pure two-argument function whose result and arguments are scalar, nonallocatable, noncoarray, nonpointer, nonpolymorphic data objects with A's type and type parameters; arguments are not optional; paired ASYNCHRONOUS, TARGET, and VALUE attributes match; the operation is mathematically associative and is the same function in corresponding references.

pending.OPERATION-pure-two-argument-function: Source-control supplies a pure integer addition function with exactly two nonoptional arguments; invalid procedures are unnumbered restrictions without diagnostic facets here.
pending.OPERATION-result-and-arguments-compatibl: Source-control uses an addition function returning a scalar integer with scalar integer arguments matching A; incompatible signatures are unnumbered restrictions without diagnostic facets here.
pending.OPERATION-arguments-not-optional: Source-control uses nonoptional function arguments; optional-argument variants are unnumbered restrictions without diagnostic facets here.
pending.OPERATION-paired-attributes-match: Source-control uses a simple operation with none of ASYNCHRONOUS, TARGET, or VALUE on either argument; mismatches are unnumbered restrictions without diagnostic facets here.
pending.OPERATION-mathematically-associative: Source-control uses integer addition as an associative operation. Mathematical associativity is a semantic program restriction with no portable diagnostic oracle for arbitrary functions.
pending.OPERATION-same-function-corresponding-re: Source-control records the same-function requirement for corresponding references; multi-image disagreement is outside single-image fixtures.

requirements.title: CO_REDUCE computes a reduction value over scalar or corresponding array elements
requirements.definition: The computed value is the result of reducing scalar A values or corresponding array elements by repeatedly applying OPERATION until one value remains.

requirements.title: CO_REDUCE does not fix pair-selection order for reductions
requirements.definition: The iterative reduction process specifies repeated removal of two set elements and insertion of OPERATION(x,y) but does not prescribe a portable pair-selection or evaluation order.
